name: Hermione's Shop
storyline:
What would you do if your best friends betrayed you and disappeared with your money? That's exactly what happened to Hermione, after which she decided to seek help from the school where she once studied. Fortunately, Dumbledore offered her the opportunity to open a potion shop.

But as we know, attracting customers is very difficult. She will have to work hard to retain them and avoid becoming a victim of debt collectors from Gringotts Bank.

The shop is located in a mysterious old laboratory that once belonged to Snape himself. What secrets might be hidden within its walls? And what will our brilliant young witch do when she finds herself in a desperate situation?
summary: Every day Hermione opens the doors of her shop with hope for a successful day. In this magical corner of Hogwarts, she must not only brew potions but also overcome all kinds of difficulties that life throws at her. Behind her looms the shadow of debts that must be paid, and expectations from Snape, who constantly monitors her work. To survive in this challenging world, Hermione must use all her skills and creativity.
